entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-13
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • [aw] Failed jobs: Issue Monster Orchestrator #55775
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #55615
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #55607
  • [aw] Issue Monster Orchestrator failed #55761
  • Scope SDK-generated MSBuild paths to the current invocation #55772
  • File-based app artifacts output path is missing project name #55692

Updated

  • [macOS arm64] dotnet-watch cleanup hangs in Process.Kill(entireProcessTree: true) #55636
  • FileWatcherTests.NewFile(False) flaky failure — Add and Update events reported out of order #55588
  • Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.New.IntegrationTests.CommonTemplatesTests.FeaturesSupport: intermittent hang (test host hang-dump timeout, exit code 7) #55551
  • Microsoft.DotNet.Watch.UnitTests.FileWatcherTests.MoveFile: flaky failure — rename source event delivered as Update instead of Delete #55518
  • Test flakiness for Microsoft.NET.Sdk.StaticWebAssets.Tests.StaticWebAssetsIntegrationTest.Build_DoesNotUpdateManifest_WhenHasNotChanged #55516
  • Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers.IntegrationTests RegistryTests.CanReadManifestFromRegistry: flaky failure - CONTAINER1014 Manifest pull failed (external registry BadRequest) #55495
  • [Known Build Error] DotnetNewTestTemplatesTests.MSTestAndPlaywrightProjectTemplate_...CanBeInstalledAndTestsArePassing fails with UnauthorizedAccessException: Access to the path 'testhost.exe' is denied #55174
  • SourceFileUpdateTests.RenameSourceFile: flaky failure — FileNotFoundException on Foo.cs / missing '> Renamed.cs' output #55137
  • MSBuild child node exits prematurely with ObjectDisposedException in BinaryLogger #55076
  • Flaky: Collection is not empty #54887
  • NavMenu.razor(1,5): error RZ10007: The attribute 'class' is used two or more times for this element. Attributes must be unique (case-insensitive) #54826
  • Test flakiness witt Microsoft.NET.Build.Tests.GivenThatWeWantBuildsToBeIncremental tests #54823
  • Template Engine SSL Connection Issue #51574
  • Workload Feature Band Test Sometimes Fails #45314
  • Failure on Helix tests - Tests timing out #40074
  • dotnet-watch tests failing #40006
  • 10.0.300 regression: dotnet watch crashes with "An item with the same key has already been added" #54552
  • [aw] Detection Runs #55753
  • Merge dotnetup getting started documentation to main #55509
  • Dotnet new react template using typescript for client app #27160
  • MSBuild server discards the build telemetry event; make telemetry testable #55749
  • Generate comhost.dll for multiple runtimes #37570
  • Aot publish failed on macos arm64 with .NET 11 #55296

PullRequests

Created

  • Prioritize issue intent for Issue Monster base branches #55778
  • Use typed Issue Monster dispatch tool #55777
  • Stop build-failure-analysis workflows from filing a public detection-runs issue #55771
  • Bump MSTest.Sdk from 4.4.0-preview.26409.6 to 4.4.0-preview.26411.1 #55768
    dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Bump Microsoft.WixToolset.Sdk from 6.0.3-dotnet.6 to 6.0.3-dotnet.14 #55767
    dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Add linux-armel RID support for NativeAOT, crossgen2 and apphost #55766
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55765

Merged

  • Use PAT pool for Issue Monster threat detection #55774
  • Work around cached Copilot CLI path mismatch #55763
  • dotnetup: treat `$host$` in `sdk.paths` as default-location sentinel, not a literal path #54686
  • Add end-to-end MSBuild telemetry coverage and fix spans #55752
  • [release/9.0.1xx] Fix the workaround for obtaining GitHub app tokens #55770
    Servicing-consider
  • Add `dotnetup` Channel Intent Docs #55390
  • Ping run-file team on relevant changes #55769
  • Add android-arm to NativeAOT runtime pack RIDs #55750
  • Place file-based app artifacts into repo's artifacts dir if used #55697
    Area-run-file
  • .NET Source-Build 9.0.120 August 2026 Updates #55751
    Servicing-approved

Updated

  • [Experiment] Add CI Quality Investigator workflow #55467
  • Enable MSBuild-backed commands in the Native AOT CLI #55497
  • Migrate templating search cache publishing to ESRP #55755
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55754
  • File-level directives: allow quoting and additional properties #55592
    Area-run-file
  • Add `dotnet pack --no-default-excludes` #55669
  • Add SolutionX item template for creating an empty slnx file #55638
